headline: The whole show goes wide
lede: Smash TV's varisize arena — the 24-column board that used to host just rooms 5 and 8 — now frames every room but THE ANNOUNCER's. The 1990 cabinet rotated its whole lens to 16:9; so does the game now.

notes.text: Rooms 1-8 pan with the camera, doors centre on each board, and the hero opens the show dead-middle of a wider studio; THE ANNOUNCER keeps his screen-sized arena by law — a boss half off-screen reads as a bug, pinned by a gate and a mutant.

The pilot floor honest-upgraded to 9/9 seeds: the documented seed-3 forced loss from #1973 is retired. The autopilot learned a DIRECTED break (slide until the road actually opens, sweeping wider each failed stall) and that when the bonus clock dies, everybody walks out a door.
smashcheck 551 checks + all 18 mutants dead; smashplay 24/24 live with camera-aware pixel probes; contractcheck 710/710; lint gates and build green. Pin and README updated together, seed-25 style.
New QA surface filed as #2011: pan readability in the six freshly wide rooms — the old pan pass predated the wide show.

look.text: Room 1 now pans — the opening wave arrives from beyond the camera edge
